highrise.example_en: Beside the station stands a new highrise with shops on the ground floor.
highrise.example_zh: 车站旁矗立着一座新的高层建筑，底层有商店。

hip.example_en: Falling off his bicycle, my brother hurt his left hip badly.
hip.example_zh: 弟弟从自行车上摔下来，把左边的臀部摔伤了。

hippo.example_en: Near the river, a huge hippo stood still and opened its wide mouth.
hippo.example_zh: 在河边，一头巨大的河马静静站着，张开了大嘴。

hockey.example_en: After school we play hockey on the field behind the gym.
hockey.example_zh: 放学后，我们在体育馆后面的场地上打曲棍球。

homage.example_en: With a short speech, the students paid homage to the old scientist.
homage.example_zh: 学生们发表简短讲话，向那位老科学家致敬。

hooray.example_en: Hooray, our class won the city basketball match this afternoon.
hooray.example_zh: 好哇，我们班今天下午赢了全市篮球赛。

hop.example_en: When the bell rings, the children hop across the playground together.
hop.example_zh: 铃一响，孩子们就一起单脚跳着穿过操场。

hotdog.example_en: Dad bought me a hotdog and a cold drink at the stadium.
hotdog.example_zh: 爸爸在体育场给我买了一个热狗和一杯冷饮。

humid.example_en: After heavy rain, the air felt humid all over the city.
humid.example_zh: 大雨过后，全城的空气都感觉很潮湿。

igloo.example_en: In the story, a family builds an igloo from blocks of snow.
igloo.example_zh: 故事里，一家人用雪块搭了一座冰屋。

impressive.example_en: Her painting of the harbour was impressive and won first prize.
impressive.example_zh: 她画的海港令人印象深刻，还得了一等奖。

incarnation.example_en: The hero is an incarnation of courage in that old adventure film.
incarnation.example_zh: 在那部老冒险片里，主人公是勇气的化身。

inclusion.example_en: Menus improve with the inclusion of fresh fruit at lunch.
inclusion.example_zh: 午餐菜单因为纳入新鲜水果而变得更好。

inconvenience.example_en: Sorry for the inconvenience, but the lift is closed for repair.
inconvenience.example_zh: 电梯正在维修，给您带来不便，非常抱歉。

ingredient.example_en: Sugar is the main ingredient in this homemade strawberry cake.
ingredient.example_zh: 糖是这块自制草莓蛋糕的主要原料。

injure.example_en: Be careful, or you may injure your knee on the icy road.
injure.example_zh: 小心，不然你可能会在结冰的路上伤到膝盖。

ink.example_en: Blue ink spilled across my notebook during the art lesson.
ink.example_zh: 美术课上，蓝墨水洒在了我的笔记本上。

inn.example_en: We stayed at a quiet inn beside the lake last weekend.
inn.example_zh: 上周末，我们住在湖边一家安静的小旅馆里。

inspector.example_en: Before the school trip, an inspector checked every bus carefully.
inspector.example_zh: 学校旅行开始前，一位检查员仔细检查了每一辆公共汽车。

instruct.example_en: Please instruct the new players before the football match starts.
instruct.example_zh: 足球比赛开始前，请指导一下新队员。

invisible.example_en: In daylight, the tiny crack in the glass was almost invisible.
invisible.example_zh: 在日光下，玻璃上的那道细裂纹几乎看不见。

invitation.example_en: I received an invitation to my cousin's birthday party on Sunday.
invitation.example_zh: 我收到了星期天参加表哥生日聚会的请柬。

italicize.example_en: Please italicize the book title when you type the reading list.
italicize.example_zh: 录入阅读书单时，请把书名排成斜体。

jar.example_en: Grandma keeps honey in a glass jar on the kitchen shelf.
jar.example_zh: 奶奶把蜂蜜装在厨房架子上的玻璃罐里。

jealous.example_en: Tom felt jealous when his brother got a new bicycle.
jealous.example_zh: 弟弟得到一辆新自行车时，汤姆感到很嫉妒。

juggle.example_en: Can you juggle three apples without dropping them on the floor?
juggle.example_zh: 你能抛接三个苹果，还不让它们掉到地上吗？

keen.example_en: Lucy is keen on swimming and goes to the pool every morning.
keen.example_zh: 露西热衷于游泳，每天早上去游泳池。

kidnap.example_en: Near the park, police stopped a man who tried to kidnap the child.
kidnap.example_zh: 在公园附近，警察拦住了一个企图绑架那个孩子的男子。

kidnapper.example_en: Last night police caught the kidnapper near the railway station.
kidnapper.example_zh: 昨晚警察在火车站附近抓住了绑架者。

kneel.example_en: Players kneel on the grass when they tie their football boots.
kneel.example_zh: 球员系足球鞋带时跪在草地上。

laboratory.example_en: Students do experiments in the laboratory during science class.
laboratory.example_zh: 科学课上，学生们在实验室里做实验。

landmark.example_en: Visitors photograph the old clock tower, a famous landmark in our city.
landmark.example_zh: 游客拍摄那座老钟楼，它是我们城市的著名地标。

laser.example_en: Doctors used a laser to treat the player's injured eye.
laser.example_zh: 医生用激光治疗了那位球员受伤的眼睛。

leaflet.example_en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about the city food festival.
leaflet.example_zh: 一位志愿者递给我一张城市美食节的传单。

lease.example_en: Before moving in, the family signed a lease for a flat near school.
lease.example_zh: 入住前，这家人签了学校附近一套公寓的租约。

lemonade.example_en: On hot days I drink lemonade under the tree in our garden.
lemonade.example_zh: 天热的日子里，我在花园的树下喝柠檬水。

licence.example_en: You need a licence before you can drive a car in the city.
licence.example_zh: 在城里开车之前，你需要有执照。

lichen.example_en: Along the mountain path, grey lichen grows on the wet rocks.
lichen.example_zh: 沿着山路，灰色的地衣长在潮湿的岩石上。

lifespan.example_en: A healthy diet can help increase a person's lifespan.
lifespan.example_zh: 健康的饮食有助于延长人的寿命。

lifestyle.example_en: Walking to work every day became part of her new lifestyle.
lifestyle.example_zh: 每天步行上班成了她新生活方式的一部分。

lifetime.example_en: Grandpa says this trip is the best holiday of his lifetime.
lifetime.example_zh: 爷爷说，这次旅行是他一生中最好的假期。

litre.example_en: Please buy one litre of milk on your way home from school.
litre.example_zh: 请在放学回家的路上买一升牛奶。

lone.example_en: A lone bird sat on the roof before the storm arrived.
lone.example_zh: 暴风雨来临前，有一只鸟独自停在屋顶上。

loosen.example_en: Loosen your tie if you feel too hot during the match.
loosen.example_zh: 如果比赛时觉得太热，就把领带松开。

lorry.example_en: At dawn a big lorry carried fresh vegetables into the market.
lorry.example_zh: 黎明时分，一辆大卡车把新鲜蔬菜运进了市场。

lunchbox.example_en: I forgot my lunchbox on the kitchen table this morning.
lunchbox.example_zh: 今天早上，我把午餐盒忘在厨房的桌子上了。

lychee.example_en: This lychee is sweet, so I bought a bag at the fruit stall.
lychee.example_zh: 这荔枝很甜，所以我在水果摊买了一袋。

madame.example_en: Madame Chen welcomed the guests at the door of the hotel.
madame.example_zh: 陈夫人在旅馆门口迎接客人。

make-up.example_en: She put on light make-up before the school concert began.
make-up.example_zh: 学校音乐会开始前，她化了淡妆。

man-made.example_en: During summer, families row on the man-made lake in the park.
man-made.example_zh: 夏天，家家户户在公园的人工湖上划船。

manual.example_en: Read the manual before you use the new camera on the trip.
manual.example_zh: 旅行中使用新相机之前，请先阅读说明书。

manufacture.example_en: Local workers manufacture bicycles for schools across the city.
manufacture.example_zh: 本地工人为全市的学校制造自行车。

mask.example_en: During the play, the actor wore a mask and played a brave hero.
mask.example_zh: 演出时，这位演员戴着面具，扮演一位勇敢的英雄。

materialistic.example_en: He is not materialistic and prefers books to expensive gifts.
materialistic.example_zh: 他并不贪图物质，比起昂贵的礼物更喜欢书。

melon.example_en: We shared a cold melon after playing basketball in the sun.
melon.example_zh: 在太阳下打完篮球后，我们分吃了一个冰镇甜瓜。

mend.example_en: Can you mend the hole in my school bag before Monday?
mend.example_zh: 你能在星期一之前补好我书包上的破洞吗？

messenger.example_en: Yesterday the messenger brought our team a letter from the coach.
messenger.example_zh: 昨天，信使给我们队带来了教练的一封信。

mike.example_en: The singer held the mike and sang for the whole school.
mike.example_zh: 歌手握着麦克风，为全校演唱。

millionaire.example_en: To build a sports centre, the millionaire gave a large sum of money.
millionaire.example_zh: 为了建造体育中心，那位百万富翁捐了一大笔钱。

miniature.example_en: She collects miniature houses and keeps them on her desk.
miniature.example_zh: 她收集微型房屋，并把它们摆在书桌上。

minibus.example_en: At seven our minibus left the school gate for the museum.
minibus.example_zh: 七点，我们的小型公共汽车从校门口出发去博物馆。

moderate.example_en: Keep a moderate speed when you ride your bike downtown.
moderate.example_zh: 在市中心骑自行车时，请保持适中的速度。

moderately.example_en: The walk was moderately long, so the children did not feel tired.
moderately.example_zh: 这段路长度适中，所以孩子们并不觉得累。

monster.example_en: Inside the cartoon, a friendly monster helps children find their home.
monster.example_zh: 动画片里，一只友善的怪物帮助孩子们找到家。

motorcycle.example_en: Every Saturday my uncle rides a motorcycle to the market.
motorcycle.example_zh: 每个星期六，我叔叔都骑摩托车去市场。

mountainous.example_en: Travel through this mountainous area is slow but the views are beautiful.
mountainous.example_zh: 穿越这一多山地区虽然慢，但景色非常美。

moustache.example_en: At noon the cook with a thick moustache served us hot noodles.
moustache.example_zh: 中午，那位留着浓密小胡子的厨师给我们端上了热面条。

multiply.example_en: If you multiply six by four, the answer is twenty-four.
multiply.example_zh: 如果你把六乘以四，答案就是二十四。

mum.example_en: Mum packed fruit and bread for our picnic by the river.
mum.example_zh: 妈妈为我们的河边野餐装好了水果和面包。

nap.example_en: After lunch Grandpa takes a short nap in his armchair.
nap.example_zh: 午饭后，爷爷在扶手椅里小睡一会儿。

nasty.example_en: A nasty wind blew sand into our eyes at the beach.
nasty.example_zh: 海滩上刮起一阵讨厌的风，把沙子吹进了我们的眼睛。

nationally.example_en: This young runner is nationally known for winning three races.
nationally.example_zh: 这位年轻的赛跑选手因赢得三场比赛而全国闻名。

naughty.example_en: While I was cooking, the naughty puppy chewed my left shoe.
naughty.example_zh: 我做饭的时候，那只淘气的小狗啃了我左边的鞋。

nib.example_en: When my pen broke, the nib snapped and I borrowed Amy's pen.
nib.example_zh: 我的钢笔坏了，笔尖断了，于是我借了埃米的笔。

non-fiction.example_en: I prefer non-fiction about animals to long adventure stories.
non-fiction.example_zh: 比起长篇冒险故事，我更喜欢关于动物的非小说类作品。

notify.example_en: Please notify the office if you cannot join the school trip.
notify.example_zh: 如果你不能参加学校旅行，请通知办公室。

obey.example_en: All players must obey the rules during the basketball game.
obey.example_zh: 所有球员在篮球比赛中都必须遵守规则。

observatory.example_en: Through a telescope at the observatory, we looked at bright stars.
observatory.example_zh: 我们在天文台用望远镜观看明亮的星星。

octopus.example_en: For dinner the cook fried an octopus and served it with rice.
octopus.example_zh: 晚餐时，厨师炸了一只章鱼，配米饭端上来。

oneself.example_en: It is important to believe in oneself when learning a new sport.
oneself.example_zh: 学习一项新运动时，相信自己很重要。

oops.example_en: Oops, I dropped the plate of noodles on the kitchen floor.
oops.example_zh: 哎呀，我把一盘面条掉在了厨房的地板上。

orchestra.example_en: At the concert our school orchestra played a cheerful piece.
orchestra.example_zh: 音乐会上，我们学校的管弦乐队演奏了一首轻快的曲子。

ought.example_en: You ought to wear a coat because the evening is cold.
ought.example_zh: 晚上很冷，你应该穿一件外套。

oval.example_en: Eight people can sit around the oval table in the dining room.
oval.example_zh: 八个人可以围坐在餐厅里的椭圆形桌子旁。

overcoat.example_en: Before dinner he hung his overcoat on a hook by the door.
overcoat.example_zh: 晚饭前，他把大衣挂在门边的钩子上。

overture.example_en: Bright music from the overture filled the hall before the opera.
overture.example_zh: 歌剧开始前，序曲明快的音乐充满了大厅。

pamphlet.example_en: Inside this pamphlet you can find the city museum's opening hours.
pamphlet.example_zh: 这本小册子里可以找到市博物馆的开放时间。

parade.example_en: Along the main street, a colourful parade moved slowly past us.
parade.example_zh: 一支色彩缤纷的游行队伍沿着大街从我们身边缓缓走过。

part-time.example_en: She found a part-time job at the bookshop after school.
part-time.example_zh: 她放学后在书店找到了一份兼职工作。

paste.example_en: Please paste the photo onto the card for your friend.
paste.example_zh: 请把这张照片粘到送给朋友的卡片上。

pat.example_en: Mum will pat the baby softly when he starts to cry.
pat.example_zh: 宝宝一开始哭，妈妈就会轻轻地拍他。

pause.example_en: Please pause the film so we can fetch some snacks.
pause.example_zh: 请把电影暂停一下，我们去拿些零食。

pavement.example_en: After dark, please keep to the pavement on your walk home.
pavement.example_zh: 天黑以后走路回家，请走人行道。

pelican.example_en: Back at the harbour, a pelican swallowed the fish it had caught.
pelican.example_zh: 回到港口后，一只鹈鹕吞下了它抓住的鱼。

pence.example_en: This pencil costs fifty pence at the shop near school.
pence.example_zh: 这支铅笔在学校附近的商店卖五十便士。

permission.example_en: You need permission from your parents before the camping trip.
permission.example_zh: 野营旅行之前，你需要得到父母的许可。

pesticide.example_en: Farmers use less pesticide so the vegetables stay safer to eat.
pesticide.example_zh: 农民少用杀虫剂，这样蔬菜吃起来更安全。

phantom.example_en: In the story a phantom appears in the old castle at night.
phantom.example_zh: 故事里，一个幽灵在夜里出现在古堡中。

photograph.example_en: In front of the palace, this photograph shows our whole family.
photograph.example_zh: 这张照片是我们全家人在宫殿前拍的。

physical.example_en: Regular physical exercise helps students stay strong and healthy.
physical.example_zh: 经常进行身体锻炼有助于学生保持强壮和健康。

pine.example_en: A tall pine stands beside the path up the hill.
pine.example_zh: 一棵高大的松树立在上山的小路旁。

pineapple.example_en: Fresh pineapple tastes wonderful with cold yoghurt after sport.
pineapple.example_zh: 运动之后，新鲜菠萝配上冰酸奶，味道好极了。

playschool.example_en: My little sister goes to playschool every weekday morning.
playschool.example_zh: 我妹妹每个工作日早上都去幼儿园。

plump.example_en: The plump baker smiled and handed us warm bread.
plump.example_zh: 那位丰满的面包师微笑着递给了我们热面包。

pop.example_en: She listens to pop on the bus every morning before school.
pop.example_zh: 她每天早上上学前在公共汽车上听流行音乐。

popcorn.example_en: During the funny film, we shared a large box of popcorn.
popcorn.example_zh: 看那部有趣的电影时，我们分吃了一大盒爆米花。

possessions.example_en: Pack your possessions carefully before you leave the hotel room.
possessions.example_zh: 离开旅馆房间之前，请小心收拾你的财物。

powder.example_en: Mum mixed milk powder with warm water for the baby.
powder.example_zh: 妈妈用温水给宝宝冲了奶粉。

prawn.example_en: At the seaside restaurant, the prawn soup tasted fresh and hot.
prawn.example_zh: 海滨餐馆的对虾汤尝起来又鲜又热。

prey.example_en: Above the open grassland, the eagle searched for prey.
prey.example_zh: 在开阔的草原上空，鹰在搜寻猎物。

principal.example_en: This morning the principal spoke to parents at the school gate.
principal.example_zh: 今天早上，校长在校门口对家长讲话。

prisoner.example_en: Every month the prisoner wrote a long letter to his family.
prisoner.example_zh: 那名囚犯每个月都给家人写一封长信。

prodigy.example_en: At the city concert hall, the young prodigy played the piano.
prodigy.example_zh: 在市音乐厅，那位年少的神童弹奏了钢琴。

pronoun.example_en: In a sentence, a pronoun can take the place of a name.
pronoun.example_zh: 在句子里，代词可以用来代替名字。

protractor.example_en: Use a protractor to measure the angle in your maths book.
protractor.example_zh: 用量角器量一量你数学书里的角。

puddle.example_en: On the way to school, the child jumped over a deep puddle.
puddle.example_zh: 在上学的路上，那个孩子跳过了一个深水坑。

puff.example_en: Suddenly a puff of wind blew the paper off the picnic table.
puff.example_zh: 突然一阵风把纸从野餐桌上吹走了。

pump.example_en: Farmers use a pump to draw water from the deep well.
pump.example_zh: 农民用泵从深井里抽水。

pumpkin.example_en: On a cold autumn evening, we made pumpkin soup for dinner.
pumpkin.example_zh: 在一个寒冷的秋夜，我们做了南瓜汤当晚餐。

puppy.example_en: Whenever someone comes home, our puppy runs to the door.
puppy.example_zh: 每当有人回家，我们的小狗就跑向门口。

puzzle.example_en: This city map puzzle has more than one hundred pieces.
puzzle.example_zh: 这幅城市地图拼图有一百多块。

pyramid.example_en: For many travellers, the pyramid in the desert is a famous sight.
pyramid.example_zh: 对许多旅行者来说，沙漠里的金字塔是一处著名景观。

quack.example_en: Ducks quack loudly when children throw bread into the pond.
quack.example_zh: 孩子们把面包扔进池塘时，鸭子会大声嘎嘎叫。

quarrel.example_en: Do not quarrel with your brother over such a small toy.
quarrel.example_zh: 不要为了这么一个小玩具和弟弟争吵。

questionnaire.example_en: Please fill in this questionnaire about your favourite school sports.
questionnaire.example_zh: 请填写这份关于你最喜欢的学校运动的问卷。

queue.example_en: Outside the stadium, a long queue formed before the big match.
queue.example_zh: 大赛开始前，体育场外排起了长队。

quiz.example_en: Our history quiz is on Friday, so I am reviewing tonight.
quiz.example_zh: 我们的历史小测验在星期五，所以我今晚在复习。

racket.example_en: I left my tennis racket in the club after practice yesterday.
racket.example_zh: 昨天训练后，我把网球拍落在俱乐部了。

raft.example_en: We crossed the calm river on a wooden raft last summer.
raft.example_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘木筏渡过了平静的河。

raincoat.example_en: Bring a raincoat because the sky looks dark this afternoon.
raincoat.example_zh: 今天下午天色阴沉，带上一件雨衣吧。

raindrop.example_en: As we left the park, a single raindrop fell on my hand.
raindrop.example_zh: 我们离开公园时，一滴雨落在了我的手上。

rarely.example_en: She rarely eats sweets because she wants to stay healthy.
rarely.example_zh: 她很少吃甜食，因为她想保持健康。

rat.example_en: Behind a bin, a rat hid after running across the street.
rat.example_zh: 一只老鼠跑过马路后，躲到了垃圾箱后面。

rear.example_en: If the front is full, please sit in the rear of the bus.
rear.example_zh: 如果前面坐满了，请坐到公共汽车的后部。

reflection.example_en: At sunset her reflection appeared clearly in the still lake.
reflection.example_zh: 日落时，她的倒影清晰地出现在平静的湖面上。

regularly.example_en: He regularly visits his grandparents on Sunday afternoons.
regularly.example_zh: 他定期在星期日下午看望祖父母。

relation.example_en: Near the seaside lives a close relation of mine.
relation.example_zh: 我的一位近亲住在海滨附近。

reproduction.example_en: Inside the museum hangs a reproduction of an ancient painting.
reproduction.example_zh: 博物馆里挂着一幅古画的复制品。

reservoir.example_en: Clean drinking water for the city comes from this reservoir.
reservoir.example_zh: 这座水库为城市提供洁净的饮用水。

revision.example_en: Evening revision helps me remember the words for Friday's test.
revision.example_zh: 晚上复习能帮我记住星期五测验要考的单词。

rex.example_en: Rex waits by the door until we come home from school.
rex.example_zh: 雷克斯在门口等着，直到我们放学回家。

ribbon.example_en: Around her mother's gift, she tied a bright red ribbon.
ribbon.example_zh: 她在给妈妈的礼物上系了一条鲜红的丝带。

rifle.example_en: Outside the museum, the guard carried a rifle all evening.
rifle.example_zh: 博物馆外面，卫兵整晚都持着步枪。

roar.example_en: Near our city, lions roar at night in the wildlife park.
roar.example_zh: 在我们城市附近的野生动物园里，狮子夜里会吼叫。

robber.example_en: Into the crowd the robber ran and dropped the stolen bag.
robber.example_zh: 强盗跑进人群，扔下了偷来的包。

robbery.example_en: Within two days the police solved the robbery at the bank.
robbery.example_zh: 警察在两天内破获了那起银行抢劫案。

role-play.example_en: We did a role-play in which I acted as a shopkeeper.
role-play.example_zh: 我们做了角色扮演，我扮演店主。

rough.example_en: During the hike, the rough stone wall scratched his hand.
rough.example_zh: 徒步时，粗糙的石墙擦伤了他的手。

rubric.example_en: Read the rubric carefully before you start the writing test.
rubric.example_zh: 开始写作测验前，请仔细阅读题目说明。

sandcastle.example_en: Before lunch the children built a sandcastle on the beach.
sandcastle.example_zh: 午饭前，孩子们在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。

saucepan.example_en: Heat the milk in a saucepan and then add the sugar.
saucepan.example_zh: 把牛奶放在煮锅里加热，然后再加糖。

scenery.example_en: From the train window, the scenery looked green and peaceful.
scenery.example_zh: 从火车窗口望去，风景翠绿而宁静。

scenic.example_en: For our drive, we chose a scenic road through the hills.
scenic.example_zh: 驾车出行时，我们选了一条穿过山丘的风景优美的路。

scratch.example_en: Do not scratch the paint on the new desk in your room.
scratch.example_zh: 不要刮花你房间里新书桌上的漆。

screamer.example_en: When the thunder started, the little screamer ran to his mum.
screamer.example_zh: 开始打雷时，那个尖叫的小孩跑向了妈妈。

script.example_en: Before the evening show, the actors read the script together.
script.example_zh: 晚场演出前，演员们一起读了剧本。

seafood.example_en: At this harbour restaurant, fresh seafood is the special dish.
seafood.example_zh: 在这家港口餐馆，新鲜海鲜是招牌菜。

seaside.example_en: Our family spends every August at the seaside with friends.
seaside.example_zh: 我们家每年八月都和朋友们在海滨度过。

sensible.example_en: It is sensible to carry water when you hike in summer.
sensible.example_zh: 夏天徒步时带上水是明智的。

sewage.example_en: From many homes, sewage goes to a new cleaning plant in the city.
sewage.example_zh: 许多家庭的污水被送到城里一座新的净化厂。

shoemaker.example_en: In less than one hour, the shoemaker repaired both my boots.
shoemaker.example_zh: 不到一个小时，鞋匠就把我的两只靴子修好了。

shopkeeper.example_en: With a smile, the shopkeeper gave the child a free apple.
shopkeeper.example_zh: 店主微笑着给了孩子一个免费的苹果。

signature.example_en: Your signature is needed on this form before the school trip.
signature.example_zh: 学校旅行之前，这份表格上需要你的签名。

sip.example_en: Sip the hot tea slowly so you do not burn your tongue.
sip.example_zh: 热茶要慢慢小口喝，以免烫到舌头。

skeleton.example_en: Every visitor stared at the dinosaur skeleton in the museum.
skeleton.example_zh: 每位游客都盯着博物馆里的恐龙骨骼看。

slam.example_en: Please do not slam the door when the baby is sleeping.
slam.example_zh: 宝宝睡觉时，请不要砰地把门关上。

slay.example_en: In the legend the knight must slay the dragon to save the town.
slay.example_zh: 传说中，骑士必须杀死恶龙才能拯救小镇。

slender.example_en: Across the bright stage, the slender dancer moved very lightly.
slender.example_zh: 苗条的舞者非常轻盈地走过明亮的舞台。

sly.example_en: In that old story, the sly fox stole food from a farm.
sly.example_zh: 在那个古老的故事里，狡猾的狐狸从农场偷走了食物。

smash.example_en: If you kick too hard, the ball may smash the kitchen window.
smash.example_zh: 如果你踢得太用力，球可能会打碎厨房的窗户。

snappy.example_en: During the team meeting, his snappy reply made everyone laugh.
snappy.example_zh: 队会期间，他干脆的回答把大家都逗笑了。

sniff.example_en: Dogs sniff the ground when they look for a lost ball.
sniff.example_zh: 狗寻找丢失的球时会嗅地面。

snore.example_en: My father may snore loudly after a long day at work.
snore.example_zh: 爸爸工作了一整天后，可能会大声打鼾。

snort.example_en: When it saw the open gate, the horse began to snort.
snort.example_zh: 那匹马看见大门敞开，就开始喷鼻息。

snowman.example_en: After the first snowfall, we built a snowman in the garden.
snowman.example_zh: 第一场雪之后，我们在花园里堆了一个雪人。

soap.example_en: Wash your hands with soap before you sit down to eat.
soap.example_zh: 坐下吃饭之前，要用肥皂把手洗干净。

sociable.example_en: Anna is sociable and talks with new students at lunch.
sociable.example_zh: 安娜很好交际，午饭时会和新同学聊天。

sometime.example_en: Let's meet sometime next week for a walk in the park.
sometime.example_zh: 我们下周找个时间去公园散步吧。

spaceship.example_en: On a quiet red planet, the spaceship in the film finally landed.
spaceship.example_zh: 电影里的宇宙飞船最终降落在一颗寂静的红色星球上。

spade.example_en: Dad used a spade to plant flowers along the garden wall.
spade.example_zh: 爸爸用铲子沿着花园的墙种下了花。

spectator.example_en: When the team scored, every spectator stood up and cheered.
spectator.example_zh: 球队进球时，每一位观众都站起来欢呼。

spice.example_en: This spice makes the chicken taste richer and warmer.
spice.example_zh: 这种香料让鸡肉吃起来更浓郁、更温热。

spicy.example_en: For my little brother, the spicy noodles were much too hot.
spicy.example_zh: 这辣面条对我弟弟来说实在太辣了。

spider.example_en: In the corner of the garage, a spider built its web.
spider.example_zh: 一只蜘蛛在车库的角落里结了网。

splash.example_en: Children splash water at each other in the swimming pool.
splash.example_zh: 孩子们在游泳池里互相溅水。

sprinkle.example_en: Sprinkle a little salt on the eggs before you serve them.
sprinkle.example_zh: 上菜之前，在鸡蛋上撒一点盐。

squid.example_en: Grilled squid is my favourite dish at the night market.
squid.example_zh: 烤鱿鱼是我在夜市最喜欢的菜。

stall.example_en: We bought oranges from a fruit stall near the station.
stall.example_zh: 我们在车站附近的水果摊买了橙子。

steady.example_en: Keep a steady pace so you can finish the long race.
steady.example_zh: 保持稳定的步伐，这样你就能完成这场长跑。

steamboat.example_en: Along the wide river, the old steamboat carried many passengers.
steamboat.example_zh: 那艘旧汽船载着许多乘客，沿着宽阔的河行驶。
